jetcars.name: AQUALUX JETCAR 1100
jetcars.tagline: The friendly one. Stable, quick to learn, and the fastest way onto the water for a first timer.

jetcars.name: AQUALUX JETCAR 1800 TURBO
jetcars.tagline: The crowd favourite. Twice the punch out of the surf line, with a longer run down the coast.

jetcars.name: AQUALUX JETCAR GT SIGNATURE
jetcars.tagline: The flagship. A full 45 minute line down Akshi Beach, timed so you finish facing the sunset.

activities.name: Jetcar Discovery Ride
activities.blurb: Your first jetcar run. A guided blast along the shore with the instructor on the seat behind you.

activities.name: Jetcar Turbo Tandem
activities.blurb: 180 HP of turbo jet drive, a full sweep of the bay, and enough time to actually learn the throttle.

activities.name: Jetcar Sunset Signature
activities.blurb: The flagship run on the GT. You leave the jetty at 16:30 and come back with the sun on your shoulder.

activities.name: Parasailing Sky Ride
activities.blurb: Winched off the boat deck up to 120 feet, with the whole Akshi coastline under your feet.

activities.name: Speed Boat Coastal Cruise
activities.blurb: A private run out to the sandbar and back. Book the whole boat and set your own pace.

activities.name: Banana Boat Blast
activities.blurb: Four to eight riders, one very determined boat driver, and a great deal of splashing.

activities.name: Kitesurf Discovery Lesson
activities.blurb: Beach briefing, kite control on the sand, then your first body drags in waist deep water.

activities.name: Beach ATV Shoreline Trail
activities.blurb: A marked loop over the wet sand at the north end of the beach, helmets included.

activities.name: Kayak and Mangrove Paddle
activities.blurb: A slow double kayak paddle into the creek mouth. The quietest half hour of your trip.

activities.name: Private Sunset Deck at Shreenika
activities.blurb: A reserved deck at Shreenika Coastal Retreat, cold towels, coconut water and the sunset over the bay.

faqs.a: A jetcar is a jet-propelled watercraft that you ride rather than sit inside. It planes on the surface, turns on a jet of water instead of a propeller, and is stable enough for a first timer with an instructor on board. It is the ride Aqualux is built around.

None. Every jetcar run starts with a five minute briefing on the sand and an instructor rides with you on the Discovery and Turbo runs. The GT Signature is also open to beginners, we just take the line down the beach more smoothly.
Swimwear or quick dry shorts, a change of clothes, sunscreen and a towel. Life jackets in every size, helmets where required, and lockers at Shreenika Coastal Retreat are included.

Riders from age 10 can go on the Discovery Ride with an adult on the same jetcar. Under 18 needs a guardian signature at check-in. Parasailing and banana boat have their own minimum age, ask at the desk.

faqs.q: When is the best time to come?
faqs.a: October to May is our season. Mornings between 06:30 and 09:00 have the flattest water; the 16:00 to 18:30 Sunset Session is the busiest, so book a day ahead for the GT.

faqs.q: How do I get to Akshi Beach?
faqs.a: Akshi is about 95 km from Mumbai and 100 km from Pune, roughly a two and a half hour drive. Alibag town is 12 km away. Shreenika Coastal Retreat is on the Akshi Beach road and we are on its shoreline.

Free rescheduling up to 12 hours before your slot. Rides cancelled by us for weather or sea conditions are rerated or fully refunded. Send a WhatsApp message with your booking reference and we will handle it.
